# Win-probability model (batch 1, 30 matches)

Every number is win-chance points for an otherwise even game (50%), learned from the matches so far; "+-" is the uncertainty across bags. Few matches = rough curves.

## How well it predicts (matches held out whole)

**Verdict: not yet better than strength alone: treat the curves as noise.** Team strength alone is the baseline; the curves below are what the game state adds to it.

Gain over strength alone (log loss, resampling whole matches): -0.095, 90% range -0.369 to +0.154.

- strength only: accuracy 62%, log loss 0.562 (0-5 min 73%; 5-10 min 66%; 10-15 min 57%; 15-end min 50%; matches lasting 15 min+ 54%; matches even on strength (gap under 200) 44%)
- glass box: accuracy 72%, log loss 0.657 (0-5 min 74%; 5-10 min 75%; 10-15 min 67%; 15-end min 69%; matches lasting 15 min+ 65%; matches even on strength (gap under 200) 64%)
- black box: accuracy 65%, log loss 1.289 (0-5 min 63%; 5-10 min 64%; 10-15 min 67%; 15-end min 68%; matches lasting 15 min+ 62%; matches even on strength (gap under 200) 68%)
